description: Use this when GifSnap is selected for conversational GIF reactions. During that reaction chat, use one matching GIF for each casual social reply, including follow-ups like haha, xd, or laughter emojis, without requiring another @mention. Preserve the topic in query: cheeseburger hungry for a burger conversation, laughing for laughter, friendly wave for hello. On haha, xd, or laughter emojis, use query laughing, without reusing a previous burger/food/object topic. Preserve a subject only when the current message actually mentions it. The component displays one GIF; respond in TEXT ONLY alongside it, without an additional image or picker. Read reaction.description so you know what was displayed. Pass recent returned reaction.id values in excludeIds to avoid repeating GIFs. Respect stop or fewer-GIF requests and omit reactions for serious or purely factual tasks. Do not send transcripts or personal information.

excludeIds.description: Up to five recent reaction.id values from this conversation to avoid repeating a GIF; omit on the first turn.

query.description: Two to six search keywords for the current topic and action, such as cheeseburger hungry, cat laughing, friendly wave, or laughing. Keep concrete subjects: a burger conversation should not become generic excitement. For a laughter-only or emoji-only follow-up, use its present emotion, e.g. laughing; do not carry forward an old object such as burger unless the user mentions it again. No personal information or transcript.

name: react_with_gif
title: React with a GIF
